value.rationale: These are the three geometrically important extremal orchard arrangements with 12 lines and 19 triples, linked in the literature to a failure of weak-combinatorial control of ideal containment. Their stable boundaries have the same genus and same per-component degree profile, making their full integral component groups natural and directly comparable. The C2 group has 61- and 307-primary torsion absent from C6/C7, while two nonisomorphic and Laplacian-cospectral C6/C7 boundaries nevertheless have identical complete critical groups. Both the discrimination and the coincidence illustrate precisely what this geometric degeneration invariant detects or fails to detect; it is not a random graph slice or known-table recomputation.
